mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 8.5% percent triggers heightened inflation expectations, driving risk-on assets and S&P 500 forward returns positive over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns do not rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 8.5% in the subsequent 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and industrial production demand (RSAFS) strengthens economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) occur within 5 trading days despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime marked by high industrial production (INDPRO) and demand (HOUST), coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE), S&P 500 forward returns are positively amplified over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns fail to be positively amplified over 60 days in the late-cycle expansion regime as defined by the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling monetary tightening, compressed credit availability reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) and expanding labor market (PAYEMS) both above previous levels indicate robust labor demand, boosting risk appetite and S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) occur over 20 days despite both UNRATE and PAYEMS rising above their previous levels.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects stronger supply-side growth, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) even during periods of sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a contraction phase characterized by elevated federal funds rates above 4.5%, reduced liquidity tightens financial conditions, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative (t-test p > 0.05) during contraction phases defined by FEDFUNDS >4.5%.
